outputs: Generated answers to natural language questions
Generated answers to the input questions
The generated answers to questions in natural language, including final scores, factual claims, and yes/no responses.

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated output descriptions and removed redundant entries. Added explicit mention of yes/no responses for StrategyQA dataset.
Normalized redundant metric names - 'token-level F1' and 'token-level F1 score' simplified to 'F1', 'Exact Match (EM)' simplified to 'Exact Match'
Removed LLM models and methods - the Judge Agent is part of the generation process (multi-agent system), not post-generation evaluation. LLMs are used for generation, not as evaluators.
No human evaluation mentioned in the paper - only automatic metrics are used for evaluation.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on improving RAG systems using multi-agent debate mechanisms. It evaluates primarily on question answering tasks using automatic metrics (Exact Match and F1). While LLMs are used extensively as part of the DRAG framework, they are not used as post-generation evaluators. The extracted metadata was generally accurate but needed normalization for metrics and clarification of role distinctions for Question 3.
